risk_note: F1-08ai (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 item 1, second of three). The admin withdrawal review list gets checkboxes and 批量通过: only an account with withdraw.review sees checkboxes, and only PENDING_REVIEW rows can be ticked; the batch bar (count and total via @couli/money, aria-live) appears only once at least one row is ticked, so the frozen F1-08a READONLY#1 / BROWSER#1 list checks still hold unchanged and no frozen case is modified. 批量通过 opens a confirmation dialog (per row 将通过, or 跳过 with the reason for a blocked pending row; the explanation never names a frozen member as skipped, per BR-WDR-10), then the shared StepUpModal (totp, BR-ID-34), then exactly one POST /admin/v1/withdrawals/batch-approve with only withdrawal_ids; per-row results (approved / skipped with not_found, not_pending, negative_balance, blocked) are shown, then the selection is cleared and the list re-read. Idempotency-Key: kept on a 10003 re-verify and on a manual resubmit after a network error with the same selection, renewed after a completed batch or a changed selection. 10403, 20001, 20901, 40901 and network errors show a failure and never resend automatically. Rule tests by Codex in three rounds (hand-written brief: the generated one was 34.9KB, over the 24KB limit); independent Claude spec-test r1 void (position check: a ledger branch of this lane was created mid-review) with one S1 (key never renewed) and two S2s, r2 pass with two S2s (frozen named as a skip reason in the dialog text; network resubmit key), r3 pass after Codex fixed both. Red on couli-ci for spec commit 3a07a528 (17 tests in 5 files, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds; r1 couli-ci verify:fast run 2 and --browser run 1 green; Codex money r1 fail with one S1 (the key was dropped after a 40901 or 5xx, so a retry after the in-flight request finished took a new key and showed the approved rows as not_pending); r2 keeps the key on every unsettled failure (network, 40901, 5xx) and drops it only on a settled 4xx rejection, couli-ci verify:fast run 4 green. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex money r1 fail (S1: key dropped after 40901/5xx, fixed in impl r2); Codex then hit its usage limit (until 2026-11-20), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the money review of r2 is by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context): pass, 0 S2

spec_test_review.note: tests by Codex; independent Claude spec-test r1 void (position check, S1 key renewal), r2 pass with two S2, r3 pass after both fixed
